candidate.title: A badge for a short game
candidate.what_is_different_here: The Today screen already counts free sessions down from 3.
candidate.placement: A card under the meter on Today.
candidate.offer_copy: Play a short game for 1 extra session this week.
candidate.decline_path: The card closes; the meter stays at 0 of 3.
candidate.ad_fail_path: No session is added and the try isn't used up.
candidate.subscriber_treatment: Subscribers have no meter and never see the card.
candidate.after_reward: Next week the meter resets to 3, and Plus removes it for good.
candidate.rationale: The weekly limit is where free users stop; one extra session keeps them going without giving the plan away.
